title: Provision productdb and pass DATABASE_URL in CI integration tests
decision: The GitHub Actions integration service uses the disposable productdb database, and the integration test command receives DATABASE_URL explicitly targeting productdb. The existing RequiredTestDatabaseURL productdb guard and isolated-schema harness remain unchanged.
rationale: The test harness intentionally rejects missing DATABASE_URL and any database other than productdb; CI was still provisioning productdb_ci_test and exporting the removed TEST_DATABASE_URL, which caused TestMain to panic. The workflow-only fix avoids application credentials or fallback behavior.
risk: The workflow contains the same non-secret disposable service-container credentials already used by the local CI database setup; they must not be reused for production.
